name: Wildcat
summary: The tailback takes the snap five yards deep, with the fullback beside him to load the edge. The quarterback leaves the backfield and lines up as a wing. Two plays: 18 Sweep and 19 Sweep.
personnel: 11 players, 2 tight ends, tailback at the snap, fullback, 2 wings (the Z and the quarterback)
notes: Seven on the line: the X, the five linemen and the Y, both ends tight. The Z and the quarterback are wings, one step outside the ends and a yard off the ball, so the ends stay eligible and the line stays seven. The tailback takes the snap five yards deep, straight behind the center; the fullback stands beside him on the side the play is going, a yard in front, and loads the edge. The call says the Z's side, and the fullback and the Z both go to the call: Z Right is 18 Sweep, Z Left is 19 Sweep. The 1 in the call is whoever takes the snap -- in Wildcat, the tailback.
